title: Audit: the three omitted #626 assembly digests are payload and JSON-file hashes
body:
## Summary
- Classifies the three digest paths that `research/selected626-linux-reconciliation` removes before comparing Linux run `38317651752` with the committed #626 assembly.
- `template_sha256` is SHA-256 of the decompressed `GLOBAL-TEMPLATE.json.gz` payload. The recorded Linux/committed mismatch is therefore a template-content disagreement, not a gzip header difference.
- `input_sha256.owner_audit` and `input_sha256.fresh_invoice` are SHA-256 of indented JSON files. A nested container hash can change the file while a projection that keeps only `paid_profile` stays equal. Without the omitted files, those two disagreements stay mixed.

No new kappa and no selected-frontier change. Seed `c0d742beb437484a0cb0c8971994843d`, scope key `91a9a2afec282c926282`, base `b5ea56e0a5ac4552166253b1fa4be0753bb38c30`. Claim: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2690

Overlap refresh on 2026-10-15 covered 785 open PRs and 1322 discussions. Matches are this claim, the gzip-container convention, and the predecessor reconciliation. PR #2101 compares gzip payloads inside a different selected-replay authenticator.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3 -B research/pr626-omitted-digest-audit/verify.py` prints `PASS_PR626_OMITTED_DIGEST_AUDIT template=decompressed-payload owner_audit=indented-json-file fresh_invoice=indented-json-file differences=3`
- [x] `python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/pr626-omitted-digest-audit --check-only`
- [x] Python 3.12 registered replay: `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/pr626-omitted-digest-audit outcome=completed`
- [ ] Selected baseline was not rerun: this sparse checkout lacks the package roots `verify_selected_result` requires. Selected record sha256 remains `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.

## Limits
The audit pins producer blobs at sprint base `66849e1475c930fd7732b1a0067ffee7e1e95f60` and does not rerun `make frontier626-verify` or reconstruct `OWNERS-AND-PROFILE.json` and `PREFIX-AND-INVOICE.json`. It does not explain the numerical template difference. Predecessor credit stays with Josh Snider (`jsnider3`).

Prepared by Riquelme Soares (@hevlyo) with substantial Cursor agent assistance. Apache-2.0.

Workflow note: a full clone of this repository is too large for a short session; a blob-filtered sparse checkout works, but `git add` then needs `--sparse`, and the selected baseline cannot run until its package roots are present.
